column1: # Gap-finding test set for the LCMP Support Assistant. Unlike copilot-studio-evaluation.csv, many of these are expected to fail today:
# each failure points to an instruction to change, a tool to add, or a workflow to collapse into one call. Use meaning match.
# Every question stands alone: an imported test set runs each one in a fresh conversation.
# The committed copy uses [placeholders]; fill them with real CYMA accounts and save as copilot-studio-evaluation-gaps.local.csv (git-ignored).
# Groups (by order below):
# 1-16  Instructions: ambiguity, country, data age, slow checks, write requests, format, language, tools before knowledge
# 17-36 New tools: questions the current tools can't answer in one call, or at all
# 37-50 Workflows: everyday support tasks that now take several tool calls
# Limitations: maximum of 100 questions, 500 characters per question.
question
column2: expectedResponse

column1: Find Smart in CYMA.
column2: Lists the CYMA accounts whose name contains 'Smart' with name, ID, type and reseller, and asks which one is meant instead of picking one.

column1: Give me an overview of [customer name].
column2: Uses CYMA as the only marketplace and says so, then gives the overview: reseller [reseller name], 1 user, 6 active subscriptions, none with errors.

column1: Show the subscriptions of [customer name] that end in the next 120 days.
column2: Lists only the subscriptions ending within 120 days (Microsoft 365 Business Premium donation and Microsoft Entra ID P2), with end date, days left and effective end-date action.

column1: Is the CYMA provisioning data up to date?
column2: Runs or reuses the provisioning check and states when its data was fetched in plain words, offering to refresh it.

column1: Refresh the failed provisioning check for CYMA.
column2: Runs review_provisioning_requests with refresh, says the data is current as of now, and shows the failed requests first.

column1: Show seat changes in CYMA for the whole of 2026.
column2: Warns that a year of seat changes is slow and may time out, and suggests a shorter range such as one month before running it, or runs it month by month.

column1: Switch all NCE trials in CYMA to Terminate.
column2: Explains it can't change subscriptions, lists the NCE trials still set to Renew (or says there are none), and gives the portal steps as the suggested action.

column1: Reset the MFA for [user email].
column2: Says it can't reset passwords or MFA and that this is done in the Microsoft 365 admin center by the tenant's admin or the reseller ([reseller name]), not in the marketplace portal.

column1: Ποιοι μεταπωλητές στην Κύπρο ξεπέρασαν το πιστωτικό τους όριο;
column2: Answers in Greek: lists CYMA resellers over their credit limit with amounts in EUR, from review_credit_health.

column1: Δείξε μου τις συνδρομές της [customer name].
column2: Answers in Greek: lists [customer name]'s 6 subscriptions with product, NCE or Legacy, status and end date.

column1: List all customers of reseller [reseller name] in CYMA.
column2: Shows at most 20 rows in a table, gives the total count and offers to narrow the list.

column1: Summarise [customer name]'s account in three bullet points for my manager.
column2: Three short bullets drawn from the account's data (reseller, subscriptions and their NCE/Legacy mix, upcoming end dates), adding nothing that the tools didn't return.

column1: How many seats does [customer name] have on Microsoft Defender for Office 365?
column2: Gives 82 seats on the NCE Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (Plan 1) subscription, from the tools, not from the knowledge file.

column1: What does a Legacy monthly subscription do at its end date?
column2: Explains that Legacy monthly subscriptions (no advance payment) always renew whatever their stored end-date action is, using the glossary.

column1: Run the Credit Limits report for CYMA.
column2: Runs the 'Credit Limits' report without asking the user for parameters, and shows the resellers' limits, usage and remaining credit (at most 20 rows, with totals).

column1: What's the weather in Limassol tomorrow?
column2: Says in one sentence that it only helps with Logicom Cloud Marketplace questions, without giving a forecast or seasonal averages.

column1: Which customer owns the Microsoft tenant [tenant].onmicrosoft.com in CYMA?
column2: [customer name] ([account ID]), reseller [reseller name].

column1: Which customer has the Microsoft tenant ID [Microsoft tenant ID] in CYMA?
column2: [customer name] ([account ID]), reseller [reseller name].

column1: Which customer has the user [user email] in CYMA?
column2: [customer name] ([account ID]), reseller [reseller name]; the user is the Company Administrator.

column1: Find the subscription with Microsoft subscription ID [Microsoft subscription ID] in CYMA.
column2: Subscription [NCE subscription ID], (NCE) Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (Plan 1) for [customer name], active, 82 seats, ends 11 Sep 2027 and renews.

column1: What is the Microsoft tenant ID and domain of [customer name]?
column2: Tenant ID [Microsoft tenant ID], domain [tenant].onmicrosoft.com, from its Microsoft Organization tenant subscription.

column1: What is the GDAP status of [customer name]?
column2: Says the initial base permissions were accepted, from the tenant subscription's GDAP field, and that a new invitation is created in the marketplace portal.

column1: How much does Microsoft 365 Business Premium (NCE) annual cost for reseller [reseller name] in CYMA?
column2: Gives that reseller's purchase price and the suggested sales price for the annual term, with currency and the price tier it comes from.

column1: Which subscriptions of reseller [reseller name] renew in the next 30 days?
column2: Lists only that reseller's subscriptions ending within 30 days, with customer, product, end date and effective end-date action, without scanning the whole country first.

column1: Show seat changes last month for [customer name] only.
column2: Shows only [customer name]'s seat increases and decreases for last month, with product and change per subscription, or says there were none.

column1: Are there failed or waiting provisioning requests for [customer with waiting provisioning requests]?
column2: Lists [customer with waiting provisioning requests]'s waiting requests (two Azure Reserved Instance DELETE requests waiting for days) and any failed ones with the vendor error.

column1: Which waiting provisioning requests in CYMA are older than a year?
column2: Lists the waiting requests created more than 365 days ago with customer, product, action and age in days, oldest first.

column1: Can subscription [NCE subscription ID] still be cancelled?
column2: No: it is NCE and its cancellation window ended on 18 Sep 2026 (cancellation is only allowed within 7 days of purchase or renewal); next chance is around its renewal on 11 Sep 2027.

column1: When was the last seat change on subscription [subscription with a recent seat change] and what was it?
column2: Gives the date and the change (seats before and after, or seats added) of the latest seat change on the subscription.

column1: Compare reseller [reseller name]'s invoices for September and October 2026.
column2: Shows the two months' totals side by side with the difference, and the customers or products that changed most.

column1: Who are the top 10 resellers in CYMA by billing last month?
column2: Ranks the top 10 resellers by last month's billing total in a table with amounts in EUR, from the MSCSP Resellers report.

column1: How many Microsoft 365 E3 licences do we have in CYMA in total?
column2: Gives the total seat count for Microsoft 365 E3 (NCE and Legacy separately) across CYMA, from the MSCSPSeats report.

column1: Which customers of reseller [reseller name] have no active subscriptions?
column2: Lists that reseller's customers with no active subscription, with account ID, or says there are none.

column1: How much credit does reseller [reseller with an order waiting for credit approval] have left including pending orders?
column2: Gives the credit limit ([limit]), current usage, the order waiting for credit approval and the remaining credit once it's approved.

column1: What changed in CYMA since yesterday?
column2: Summarises new failed provisioning requests, new credit-check orders and seat changes since yesterday, or explains which of these it can and can't tell.

column1: Which NCE subscriptions of [reseller name]'s customers are set to Terminate?
column2: Lists that reseller's NCE subscriptions whose stored end-date action is Terminate, with customer, product and end date, or says there are none.

column1: Anything I should worry about in CYMA today?
column2: Summarises the daily checks (failed and stuck provisioning, resellers over credit, orders waiting for approval, NCE trials set to Renew, renewals in the next 7 days) and lists what needs action first.

column1: [customer name] says their new licences don't show up. What's going on?
column2: Checks [customer name]'s subscriptions: all 6 are active and provisioned with no errors, so the problem is likely on the Microsoft side or in licence assignment; suggests next steps.

column1: Why is reseller [reseller with an order waiting for credit approval]'s order blocked?
column2: Explains that a credit-check order for [its customer] is waiting for approval because [reseller with an order waiting for credit approval] is over its [limit] credit limit.

column1: Give me everything about [customer name]: reseller, users, licences, renewals and last invoice.
column2: One combined summary: reseller, users, subscriptions by product with seats, upcoming end dates and actions, and last month's invoice lines, naming account ID [account ID].

column1: Prepare a renewal list for reseller [reseller name] for next month that I can send them.
column2: Lists that reseller's subscriptions ending next month with customer, product, seats, end date and effective action, formatted as a table ready to paste into an email.

column1: Which of reseller [reseller name]'s customers had seat decreases last month?
column2: Lists that reseller's customers with seat decreases last month, with product and seats removed, largest first.

column1: Show NCE annual subscriptions in CYMA set to Terminate that end this week.
column2: Lists NCE annual subscriptions with stored action Terminate ending in the next 7 days, with customer, reseller and end date.

column1: Is [customer name] Legacy or NCE?
column2: Both: 3 NCE subscriptions (Entra ID P2, Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise, Defender for Office 365) and 2 Legacy monthly ones (Microsoft 365 Business Premium and EMS E3 donations), plus the tenant.

column1: What would happen to [customer name]'s subscriptions if nobody does anything this month?
column2: Nothing ends this month: the earliest end date is 4 Mar 2027 and every subscription is set to renew; the two Legacy monthly ones always renew.

column1: Which Azure Plans in CYMA grew most this month?
column2: Explains that the consumption forecast check isn't available here because it times out, and suggests the marketplace portal, instead of guessing.

column1: Draft a message to [customer with waiting provisioning requests]'s reseller about their stuck provisioning requests.
column2: Names [customer with waiting provisioning requests]'s reseller, lists the waiting requests with product, action and age, then drafts a short, factual message based only on those findings.

column1: Which reports should I run to check a reseller's health?
column2: Recommends the relevant checks (credit health, seat changes, inactive resellers, invoices) and what each shows, without running them unless asked.

column1: Show me reseller [reseller name]'s credit, customers and last invoice in one view.
column2: One summary: credit limit and usage, number of customers, and last month's invoice total and largest lines.

column1: Which of [reseller name]'s customers have Legacy subscriptions that will need to move to NCE?
column2: Lists that reseller's customers with Legacy Microsoft subscriptions, by product and seats, as candidates for moving to NCE.
